title: 第857章 竟然杀我第856章 救林蔓
slug: 领证爽约我转嫁你哥哭什么
content_zh:
柳思哲还在犹豫。
洛智博一把抓住他的手：“人是活的，时间是死的，赶紧下决定！”
“行，行动！”
柳思哲立刻拿出对讲机，对着那边吩咐：“行动！”
那头立刻回应：“收到。”
洛智博脸上终于浮起满意的神色。
此时防空洞里面。
林蔓缓缓从那股眩晕里面回过神来。
看到站在床边背对着她的身影，心口狠狠一颤。
原来都是真的。
晕倒前看到沈景辞都是真的。
林蔓眼底浮起抹绝望，“杀了我吧。”
她无力地看着洞顶，眼里没有了半点求生的意志。
沈景辞听到她细如蚊蝇的声音，缓缓转过身来，盯着她：
“我对你不够好吗？”
林蔓把脸转过去，跟他对视：“以前挺好的。”
沈景辞眼眸微转，“我可以解释，那时候我并不是嫌……”
他的声音落下，却被身后一道道惨叫声掩盖。
沈景辞转过身，朝着洞口看过去。
一波身影涌进来，为首的黑色身影在防空洞的灯光照射下，如同死神来临一般。

“沈景辞！”
沈云翔一双锋利的眸子，死死盯着沈景辞。
几个手下倒在地上，发出痛苦的哀嚎。
沈景辞看到来人，眉头深深皱了起来。
“果真是你。”
林蔓躺在床上，虽然腹部没有之前绞痛得厉害，可她还是有瞬间觉得自己出现幻听了。
她好像听到了沈云翔的声音。
可她没有转头去看，因为她怕失望。
一次次的失望只会让她更加不想再活下去。
她绝望地闭上了眼睛，兴许，她马上就要死了吧？
然而这时，许雾激动的声音响了起来：
“林蔓，真的是你吗？”
“林蔓是我，许雾，我们来了！”
“蔓蔓！”
“蔓蔓！”
几人异口同声喊着躺在床上的林蔓。
林蔓浑身一颤，身上的血液仿佛凝固住了似的。
她猛地睁开眼睛，怔了几秒，缓缓扭头看了过去。
只见洞口黑压压地站着一群人，灯光洒在他们的身上，照出一张张熟悉的脸。
尤其为首的男人，那张脸瘦削得更加立体英俊。

虽然没了往日的儒雅温润，可林蔓还是一眼就认出了他，瞬间热了眼眶。
“云翔！”
林蔓颤抖着声音，“是你吗？是你们吗？”
content_en:
Liu Sizhe was still hesitating.
Luo Zhibo grabbed his hand: "People are alive, time is dead, make a decision quickly!"
"Okay, take action!"
Liu Sizhe immediately took out his walkie-talkie and commanded: "Act!"
The other end responded immediately: "Roger that."
A look of satisfaction finally appeared on Luo Zhibo's face.
Inside the air raid shelter at this time.
Lin Man slowly recovered from the dizziness.
Seeing the figure standing by the bed with his back to her, his heart trembled.
It turns out it's all true.
It was true that he saw Shen Jingci before he fainted.
Lin Man's eyes were filled with despair, "Kill me."
She looked helplessly at the ceiling of the cave, with no will to survive in her eyes.
When Shen Jingci heard her voice as thin as a mosquito or fly, he slowly turned around and stared at her:
"Am I not good enough for you?"
Lin Man turned her face away and looked at him: "It was good before."
Shen Jingci rolled his eyes slightly, "I can explain that at that time I didn't dislike..."
His voice fell, but was covered up by the screams behind him.
Shen Jingci turned around and looked towards the entrance of the cave.
A wave of figures came in, and the black figure at the head looked like the god of death coming under the light of the air-raid shelter.
"Shen Jingci!"
Chen Yunxiang's sharp eyes stared at Shen Jingci.
Several of his men fell to the ground, wailing in pain.
Shen Jingci frowned deeply when he saw the person coming.
"It's really you."
Lin Man was lying on the bed. Although her abdomen was not as cramped as before, she still felt for a moment that she was hallucinating.
She seemed to hear Chen Yunxiang's voice.
But she didn't turn around to look, because she was afraid of being disappointed.
Repeated disappointments only made her want to live even more.
She closed her eyes in despair. Maybe she was going to die soon?
However, at this time, Xu Wu's excited voice rang out:
"Lin Man, is it really you?"
"Lin Man, it's me, Xu Wu, we're here!"
"Manman!"
"Manman!"
Several people shouted in unison to Lin Man who was lying on the bed.
Lin Man trembled, and the blood in his body seemed to have frozen.
She opened her eyes suddenly, was stunned for a few seconds, and then slowly turned her head to look over.
I saw a group of people standing in darkness at the entrance of the cave. The light shone on them, illuminating familiar faces.
Especially the head man, whose face is thinner and more three-dimensional and handsome.
Although he was no longer as elegant and gentle as before, Lin Man still recognized him at a glance, and her eyes instantly filled with tears.
"Yunxiang!"
Lin Man's voice trembled, "Is it you? Is it you?"
